stories.title: Vier nieuwe doden door westnijlvirus, maar uitbraak lijkt af te vlakken

en.title: Four new deaths from West Nile virus, but outbreak appears to be flattening
en.summary: Four people died from West Nile virus in the past week in the Netherlands. Despite this being the largest weekly increase since cases began in August, health authorities believe the outbreak has passed its peak.

stories.title: Taalinstituut Paulien Cornelisse was geen schoolmeester, maar zette haar ‘afwijking met woorden’ met humor in

en.title: Language institute Paulien Cornelisse was no schoolmaster, but used her 'deviation with words' with humor
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse led a language institute and approached her work with humor rather than conventional teaching methods.

stories.title: Nog vier patiënten met westnijlvirus overleden: 'Piek van uitbraak lijkt geweest'

en.title: Four more patients with West Nile virus died: 'Peak of outbreak appears to have passed'
en.summary: Twelve new West Nile virus infections were reported this week, with four patients dying. Health authorities expect the outbreak's peak to have already occurred.

stories.title: Getuigen beschrijven mislukte executie Christa Pike: 'Ze hebben het verkloot'

en.title: Witnesses describe botched execution of Christa Pike: 'They messed it up'
en.summary: The execution of 50-year-old Christa Pike in Tennessee failed when she remained alive after two lethal injections. The state has suspended further executions pending an investigation into what went wrong.

stories.title: EU stopt met steun aan Sierra Leone vanwege voorvluchtige 'Bolle Jos'

en.title: EU halts aid to Sierra Leone over fugitive 'Bolle Jos'
en.summary: The European Commission has immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone because the country is not cooperating with the extradition of drug criminal 'Bolle Jos', confirmed by Dutch Justice Minister David van Weel.

stories.title: Tennessee schort uitvoering doodstraf tijdelijk op na mislukte executie Pike

en.title: Tennessee suspends death penalty executions after failed Pike execution
en.summary: Tennessee has immediately halted executions following a failed execution of Christa Pike, who received two lethal injections on Wednesday but survived and was transported to a hospital alive.

stories.title: Bolle Jos nu ook in Europa op agenda: betalingen stopgezet aan Sierra Leone

en.title: Bolle Jos now on Europe's agenda: payments to Sierra Leone halted
en.summary: The European Commission has immediately suspended payments to Sierra Leone totaling 18 million euros this year due to the country's refusal to cooperate with extraditing drug criminal Bolle Jos, with additional future payments also at risk.

stories.title: Omstreden executie Christa Pike mislukt, staat Tennessee schort executies op. 'Dit is het ergste incident dat we hebben meegemaakt'

en.title: Controversial Christa Pike execution fails, Tennessee suspends executions. 'This is the worst incident we have experienced'
en.summary: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, remained alive hours after receiving two lethal injections, with her attorneys claiming the process caused unnecessary suffering.

stories.title: Christa Pike krijgt dodelijke injecties maar overleeft executie in Tennessee

en.title: Christa Pike receives lethal injections but survives execution in Tennessee
en.summary: Death row inmate Christa Pike in Tennessee received lethal injections but survived the execution procedure.

stories.title: Omstreden executie Christa Pike mislukt; Tennessee schort executies op

en.title: Controversial Christa Pike execution fails; Tennessee suspends executions
en.summary: An execution in Tennessee of convicted murderer Christa Pike went severely wrong when she remained conscious after two lethal injections, prompting the state to suspend further executions.

stories.title: In alles wat Paulien Cornelisse aanraakte knetterde haar volstrekt unieke en originele geest

en.title: In everything Paulien Cornelisse touched crackled her completely unique and original spirit
en.summary: Author, columnist, and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse explored topics ranging from her fascination with language to her personal experience with illness, bringing her distinctive perspective to audiences.

stories.title: Europe stops aid to Sierra Leone over refusal to extradite Dutch drug fugitive Bolle Jos

en.title: Europe stops aid to Sierra Leone over refusal to extradite Dutch drug fugitive Bolle Jos
en.summary: The European Commission suspended all aid to Sierra Leone because the country refused to extradite Dutch drug trafficker Jos Leijdekkers.
